fieldData.acrm---key-feature-4-content:
Every accident type reaches its owner

Send vehicle crashes to the fleet manager by email and injuries to HR in Slack. A report that mentions a hospital visit also alerts the safety lead the moment it is filed.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-1:
Back strains that need a clinic reach HR the same day

Mattresses are heavy, and housekeepers lift them all shift. At Harborview Hotel, a housekeeper strains her lower back turning one in room 412. Her supervisor files the report with the task and the treatment. Any injury treated beyond first aid posts to the HR channel in Slack the same day, and this one went to a clinic.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-2:
A fall in the shrub aisle goes on record with a witness

Garden hoses cross the shrub aisle at Greenleaf Garden Center, and a customer catches one with her foot and falls. A cashier who saw it types a short statement and signs on the staff tablet. The report holds 2 photos of the aisle and notes that the customer declined an ambulance. Tom, the owner, has it before closing.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { companyVehicles: "I manage a plumbing company with a fleet of service vans. Build an accident report my drivers fill out on their phones at the scene: the van number, the location, photos of the damage, the other driver's plate and insurer, and the police report number. When a crash involves another vehicle, email the whole report to our fleet manager.", employeeInjuries: "I run HR for a hotel. Build an injury report supervisors file when a housekeeper or porter gets hurt at work: the room or area, the task they were doing, the body part, and the treatment. If the injury needed more than first aid, send it to me in Slack the same day so I can start the claim.", customerFalls: "I own a garden center. Build an accident report my staff fill out on the store tablet when a customer trips or falls. Record the aisle, what happened, photos, whether the customer accepted medical help, and a statement and signature from any staff member who saw it. Email each report to me before closing.", claimFollowUp: "I'm the risk manager for a property management company. Link every accident report to its insurance claim number, with the property and the date the claim opened. Show me all open claims with the days each has been open, and put any claim open more than 30 days on a follow-up list with a button to email the adjuster." };
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-4-des: Decide who receives each kind of accident and how. Crashes might email the fleet manager while injuries post to an HR channel in Slack. Anything with a hospital visit can alert the safety lead too. Name a backup for nights and weekends.
fieldData.afb---prompt: Build an accident report form employees can fill out on a phone, right where it happened.

acrm---key-feature-2-image.alt: A Harborview Hotel supervisor files a lower back strain from room 412, and because the housekeeper went to a clinic, the report posts to the HR channel in Slack the same day for Omar.

acrm---key-feature-3-image.alt: A Greenleaf Garden Center cashier records a customer's fall in the shrub aisle with a signed witness statement and 2 photos, and the report goes to Tom, the owner.

fieldData.awb---integration-feature-2:
Each yes goes to Dr. Esterly before the visit

Every patient at Cordova Skin Clinic answers the health questions written by its medical director, Dr. Theo Esterly. Lisette Hartwell fills in her form on Sunday and answers yes to the medicines question. Dr. Esterly gets an email with her answer at the top, 2 days before her Tuesday appointment.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { injectorTreatmentNotes: "I run Saffron Hill Aesthetics. Build a botox consent form patients e-sign before the visit. After the treatment, let the injector open the same record and add the product, the lot number, and the areas treated, such as forehead lines and crow's feet. Give me a search by lot number that lists every patient treated from that lot.", beforeAndAfterPhotos: "My skin studio takes before and after photos at every visit. Build a photo consent question with two choices: chart only, or chart and marketing. Tag every photo saved to the patient record with that choice, and give my marketing team a gallery that shows only photos tagged for marketing.", medicalDirectorReview: "Our medical director writes the health questions on our botox consent form. Make each one a yes or no field with a box for details. When a patient answers yes to any of them, email the medical director with that answer at the top, 2 days before the appointment.", updatedConsentWording: "We just changed our consent wording to version 4. Build a consent form that records which version each patient signed. Returning patients who signed version 3 should get the new wording with their next booking reminder. Keep the old signature on the record, and show me how many have signed version 4 so far." };
fieldData.afb---how-to-step-7-des: Fill in the form twice yourself, once as a new patient who answers yes to a health question and once as a returning patient on the old wording. Check that the medical director gets the email and the new version appears, then open both records.
fieldData.afb---prompt: Build a botox consent form that saves every response to a database I own.

acrm---key-feature-3-image.alt: Lisette Hartwell answers yes to the medicines question on her Sunday form at Cordova Skin Clinic, and medical director Dr. Theo Esterly gets an email with that answer first, 2 days before her Tuesday appointment.

fieldData.awb---integration-feature-1:

Her yes to the car accident question opens four more: the accident date, her auto insurer, the claim number, and her attorney. The intake goes by email to case coordinator Wendell Kim instead of the health plan queue.

Ask patients to tap each spot that hurts on a front and back body chart, rate it from 0 to 10, say when it started and what they were doing, and pick what makes it worse. Email the chiropractor when the intake is ready, and keep the answers in the app for the exam.", carAccidentCases: "Build an intake for Sorrel Ridge Chiropractic that asks whether a car accident caused the pain. On a yes, ask for the accident date, the auto insurer, the claim number, and the attorney, if there is one. acrm---key-feature-2-image.alt: Elodie Marsh answers yes to the car accident question on the Sorrel Ridge Chiropractic intake, adds the Oct 28 accident date, her auto insurer, claim number and attorney, and the intake goes by email to case coordinator Wendell Kim.

fieldData.acrm---key-feature-3-content:
Severity decides who hears first

Set the rules that route each report. A serious injury emails the safety lead at once, a broken shelf goes to facilities, and a minor scrape waits for the weekly review list.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-1:
A parent signs for every bite before pickup

Bites happen in toddler rooms, and parents expect to hear the same day. At Little Oak Early Learning, a teacher logs a bite on the playground with the first aid given, using initials only. The report goes to the parent's phone, and the parent reads and signs it before pickup. The director sees any report still unsigned.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { warehouseFloors: "I run a distribution warehouse with forklifts on every shift. Build a near miss report my pickers file from a phone: location, what happened, and photos. If the near miss involves a forklift, send a Slack message to the shift supervisor right away. Let the supervisor add a corrective action with an owner and a due date on the same report.", childcareCenters: "I direct a childcare center. Build an incident report teachers fill in after a bite, fall or injury: the time, the room, what happened, the first aid given, and children's initials only. Send the report to the parent's phone so they can read and sign it before pickup, and show me which reports are still unsigned.", retailStoreTheft: "We run a chain of grocery stores. Build a theft report shift leads fill in with the store, the items taken, the estimated loss, and the camera timestamp. If the estimated loss is over $200, send the report to our regional loss prevention lead. Add smaller losses to a monthly count for each store.", restaurantGroups: "I run operations for a restaurant group with four kitchens. Build one incident report for every location, with the type of incident such as a burn, a cut or a slip. Give me a dashboard of reports by location and type for the quarter, and flag any kitchen with far more incidents of one type than the others." };
fieldData.afb---prompt: Build an incident report form my team can fill out on a phone as soon as something goes wrong at work.

acrm---key-feature-2-image.alt: At Little Oak Early Learning, a bite report with the child's initials and the first aid given goes to the parent's phone to sign before pickup, and the director's list shows which reports are still unsigned.

fieldData.acrm---key-feature-4-content:
Holds set by the answers

Hold a booking when an answer needs a conversation first, such as a recent operation. The lead therapist hears about it in Slack or by email before the client arrives.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-2:
Deep tissue waits for a call after recent knee surgery

Kestrel Sports Massage books deep tissue online, and its intake asks for the date of any surgery in the last 12 weeks. A runner who reports knee surgery 6 weeks ago keeps her slot, but it stays on hold. Owen Tate, the lead therapist, gets a Slack message to call her and confirms the booking after they talk.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { soloTherapists: "I run a one-person massage practice. Build an intake form that opens with each regular's answers from their last visit already filled in, so they confirm or edit them. Highlight anything they change, such as a new medication or an injury, at the top of my session sheet for that appointment. New clients get the full form with pressure, areas to avoid and a signature.", daySpas: "My day spa needs a massage intake form that asks every guest about pregnancy and, if the answer is yes, how many weeks along. Move any pregnant guest off the general Swedish booking and onto the schedule of a therapist trained in prenatal massage. Add a note to the room asking for a side-lying setup with extra pillows.", sportsMassage: "My sports massage clinic books deep tissue sessions online. Ask every client for the date of any surgery in the last 12 weeks. If there is one, keep the slot but put it on hold, and send our lead therapist a Slack message to call the client. The booking is confirmed only after he marks the call done.", chairMassage: "I run chair massage at office wellness days. Build a short intake employees open from a QR code on their phones: three screening questions, areas to avoid and a signature. Each signed form should take the next open 15-minute slot, and the therapist needs a list on a tablet showing everyone in order with their areas to avoid." };
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-4-des: Name the person who reads each flagged answer: the lead therapist for health questions, the front desk for pregnancy rebookings. Pick Slack or email for each one, and give every flag a fallback for the days that person is off.

fieldData.acrm---key-feature-4-content:
Alerts for answers that need a person

Alert the staff member who owns an answer by email or in Slack once it arrives. A plan outside the accepted list goes to billing; a referral sent without labs goes to scheduling.
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-4-des: Decide which answers need a person before the visit: an insurance plan you do not accept, a missing referral, a symptom the nurse wants flagged. Name one staff member for each, and choose whether they hear about it by email or in Slack.

fieldData.acrm---key-feature-5-content:
Alerts to the stylist on the booking

An answer can trigger an email or a Slack message to the stylist who has the appointment. Clients who have not signed yet get a reminder email before they arrive at the salon.

fieldData.acrm---key-feature-5-content:
Alerts on answers that need a person

Alert whoever owns an answer by email or in Slack: the clinical director for a safety question, or the billing lead for an insurance plan outside your practice's network.
fieldData.acrm---integration-feature-4:
Scored screeners, and one answer that cannot wait

Northgate Community Mental Health puts the PHQ-9 and GAD-7 inside its adult intake, and both totals are scored on submit. Any answer other than "Not at all" on PHQ-9 item 9, the question about thoughts of self-harm, alerts Dr. Owen Marsh, the clinical director, to call the client that day.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { groupPractice: "I run a group counseling practice and need a therapy intake form for new clients. Ask what brings them in and whether they want telehealth. When they submit, show the clinicians who treat that concern and have an opening, and let them book one on the same screen. Send anyone with no match to Rosa Delgado, our intake coordinator, for a call back.", couplesTherapy: "My couples practice needs an intake where each partner gets a separate link to the same questions, including a rating of the relationship out of 10. Neither partner should be able to open the other's answers. Show the therapist both responses side by side, and open booking for the first joint session only once both forms are in.", teenCounseling: "Build an adolescent intake split between teen and parent. The teen gets a private link with questions about school and sleep, and only the counselor can see those answers. The parent adds family history and signs the consent for treatment. Do not let anyone book the first session until the parent has signed.", communityClinic: "My community mental health clinic needs an adult intake that includes the PHQ-9 and GAD-7. Score both totals when the client submits and show them on the clinician's intake summary. If a client answers anything other than Not at all on PHQ-9 item 9, alert Dr. Owen Marsh, our clinical director, to call them that day." };
